paracetamol.use_zh: 用於紓緩疼痛及退燒；複方感冒藥亦可能含有此成分。
paracetamol.use_en: Used for pain and fever; it may also occur in combination cold medicines.
paracetamol.side_effects_zh: 可出現過敏；過量可造成嚴重肝損傷。
paracetamol.side_effects_en: Allergic reactions can occur; overdose can seriously injure the liver.
paracetamol.precautions_zh: 先核對其他藥物有沒有相同成分；肝病或正服華法林者先問醫護。
paracetamol.precautions_en: Check other medicines for the same ingredient; discuss liver disease or warfarin use with a professional.

ibuprofen.use_zh: 可紓緩疼痛、炎症及發燒。
ibuprofen.use_en: Used to relieve pain, inflammation and fever.
ibuprofen.side_effects_zh: 可能胃部不適、出血；腎臟及心血管風險須評估。
ibuprofen.side_effects_en: Stomach upset or bleeding may occur; kidney and cardiovascular risks need assessment.
ibuprofen.precautions_zh: 有胃潰瘍、腎病、哮喘、懷孕或正服薄血藥時，先請醫護核實。
ibuprofen.precautions_en: Ask a professional about ulcers, kidney disease, asthma, pregnancy or blood-thinner use.

naproxen.use_zh: 可紓緩疼痛、炎症及發燒。
naproxen.use_en: Used to relieve pain, inflammation and fever.
naproxen.side_effects_zh: 可能胃部不適、出血；腎臟及心血管風險須評估。
naproxen.side_effects_en: Stomach upset or bleeding may occur; kidney and cardiovascular risks need assessment.
naproxen.precautions_zh: 有胃潰瘍、腎病、哮喘、懷孕或正服薄血藥時，先請醫護核實。
naproxen.precautions_en: Ask a professional about ulcers, kidney disease, asthma, pregnancy or blood-thinner use.

aspirin.use_zh: 低劑量處方可用於減少血小板聚集；用途取決於處方。
aspirin.use_en: Low-dose treatment may reduce platelet aggregation; the purpose depends on the prescription.
aspirin.side_effects_en: Stomach problems and bleeding can occur.
aspirin.precautions_zh: 不要因這張資料卡自行開始或停止服用；與其他薄血藥合用須核實。
aspirin.precautions_en: Do not start or stop it from this card; combinations with other blood thinners need review.

warfarin.use_zh: 用於預防或治療特定血栓相關情況，須按個人處方及監測安排。
warfarin.use_en: Used for selected clot-related conditions under individual prescribing and monitoring.
warfarin.precautions_zh: 其他藥物、草藥及飲食變化可能影響治療；不可由藥盒推斷個人劑量。
warfarin.precautions_en: Other medicines, herbal products and diet changes can affect treatment; a box cannot establish the personal dose.

clopidogrel.use_zh: 減少血小板聚集，用於特定心腦血管處方。
clopidogrel.use_en: Reduces platelet aggregation in selected cardiovascular prescriptions.
clopidogrel.precautions_zh: 新加胃藥或其他薄血藥前先核實；不要自行停處方。
clopidogrel.precautions_en: Check new acid-suppressing or blood-thinning medicines with a professional; do not stop a prescription yourself.

omeprazole.use_zh: 減少胃酸，用於胃酸相關疾病的處方或治療安排。
omeprazole.use_en: Reduces stomach acid in acid-related conditions.
omeprazole.side_effects_zh: 可能頭痛、噁心或腹瀉；不是完整副作用清單。
omeprazole.side_effects_en: Headache, nausea or diarrhea may occur; this is not a complete list.
omeprazole.precautions_zh: 正服氯吡格雷者須核實合用；劑型和療程依實際處方。
omeprazole.precautions_en: Concurrent clopidogrel requires review; formulation and treatment duration depend on the prescription.

esomeprazole.use_zh: 減少胃酸，用於胃酸相關疾病的處方或治療安排。
esomeprazole.use_en: Reduces stomach acid in acid-related conditions.
esomeprazole.side_effects_zh: 可能頭痛、噁心或腹瀉；不是完整副作用清單。
esomeprazole.side_effects_en: Headache, nausea or diarrhea may occur; this is not a complete list.
esomeprazole.precautions_zh: 正服氯吡格雷者須核實合用；劑型和療程依實際處方。
esomeprazole.precautions_en: Concurrent clopidogrel requires review; formulation and treatment duration depend on the prescription.

simvastatin.use_zh: 降低膽固醇，部分處方用於減低心血管事件風險。
simvastatin.use_en: Lowers cholesterol and may reduce cardiovascular risk in selected patients.
simvastatin.side_effects_zh: 可能胃部不適；不明原因肌肉痛或無力需及時求醫。
simvastatin.side_effects_en: Stomach symptoms can occur; unexplained muscle pain or weakness needs prompt medical advice.
simvastatin.precautions_zh: 新加抗生素等藥物前要核實相互作用。
simvastatin.precautions_en: Check interactions before adding medicines such as antibiotics.

clarithromycin.use_zh: 用於特定細菌感染，不治療一般病毒性感冒。
clarithromycin.use_en: Treats certain bacterial infections; it does not treat viral colds.
clarithromycin.side_effects_zh: 可能噁心、腹瀉或味覺改變。
clarithromycin.side_effects_en: Nausea, diarrhea or taste changes may occur.
clarithromycin.precautions_zh: 與辛伐他汀等藥物可有重要相互作用；按處方療程使用。
clarithromycin.precautions_en: Important interactions include simvastatin; follow the prescribed treatment course.

sildenafil.use_zh: 本次資料介紹用於勃起功能障礙的藥物；其他適應症不可由此推斷。
sildenafil.use_en: This source discusses treatment of erectile dysfunction; it does not establish other indications.
sildenafil.side_effects_zh: 可能頭痛、面紅或血壓下降。
sildenafil.side_effects_en: Headache, flushing or lowered blood pressure may occur.
sildenafil.precautions_zh: 不能把硝酸鹽類藥物合用當作安全；需醫護核實。
sildenafil.precautions_en: Combination with nitrate medicines needs urgent professional review.

glyceryl trinitrate.use_zh: 舌下片可用於心絞痛的個人治療安排。
glyceryl trinitrate.use_en: Sublingual tablets are used in individualized angina treatment.
glyceryl trinitrate.side_effects_zh: 可能頭痛、頭暈或低血壓。
glyceryl trinitrate.side_effects_en: Headache, dizziness or low blood pressure may occur.
glyceryl trinitrate.precautions_zh: 舌下片與吞服片不同；務必核實實際劑型及處方，不依本卡決定救急劑量。
glyceryl trinitrate.precautions_en: Sublingual and swallowed tablets differ; confirm formulation and prescription. This card does not set an emergency dose.

guaifenesin.use_zh: 用於幫助排痰，複方藥可能同時含止痛或鼻塞藥成分。
guaifenesin.use_en: Helps loosen phlegm; combination products may include other active ingredients.
guaifenesin.side_effects_en: Nausea, vomiting or headache may occur.
guaifenesin.precautions_zh: 核對複方全部成分；兒童或持續咳嗽須專業評估。
guaifenesin.precautions_en: Check every ingredient; children or persistent cough need professional assessment.

phenylephrine hydrochloride.use_zh: 部分感冒複方含此成分；本卡不判定產品療效或個人是否適用。
phenylephrine hydrochloride.use_en: An ingredient in some cold products; this card does not establish efficacy or personal suitability.
phenylephrine hydrochloride.side_effects_en: Nervousness, dizziness or difficulty sleeping may occur.
phenylephrine hydrochloride.precautions_zh: 有高血壓、心臟病或正在服其他藥物時先核實；不要把複方只當止痛藥。
phenylephrine hydrochloride.precautions_en: Discuss high blood pressure, heart disease and other medicines with a professional; a combination is not just a painkiller.

storage.zh: 先看實際藥袋／標籤的貯存要求，保留原容器並避免兒童接觸；不同製劑要求可不同，不自動假定可放雪櫃。
storage.en: Follow the actual label storage instructions, retain the original container and keep away from children. Requirements vary; do not assume refrigeration is appropriate.
